Trace, implement and test: Java8 Interface2

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
@FunctionalInterface
interface Test {
    int myFunction(int a, int b, int c);
}

class TestClass implements Test {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Test t1 = (int a, int b, int c) -> a + b + c;
        Test t2 = (int a, int b, int c) -> a * b * c;
        System.out.println("5 + 10 + 3 = " + t1.myFunction(5, 10, 3));
        System.out.println("5 * 10 * 3 = " + t2.myFunction(5, 10, 3));
    }

    @Override
    public int myFunction(int a, int b, int c) {
        return 0;
    }
}
